svg.title: Trace a public claim back to the original evidence
svg.desc: A post can repeat an announcement without its date or conditions. Check the original before relying on it. Claim. Write down what the post says happened. Source. Follow the link to the official announcement and check its date. Decision. Read the passage. Keep only the part of the claim it actually supports.
